distance_bucket_meta.definition: D34 = 3<=dist<=4; D5 = dist>=5 finite; self and dist<=2 excluded; unreachable excluded

device_note: rr sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES per pool; the pool GPU is cuda:0 in-process

w_out_zero_ablation_valid.note: same best-epoch model with the correction output projection zeroed in eval

model_audit.definition: h_new_i = h_i + W_out(tanh(W_atom h_i) * (p34_i + p5_i)); p34_i = has34_i*tanh(W_34 c34_i), c34_i = mean_{j in D34_i} h_j (root i); p5_i = has5_i*tanh(W_5 c5_i), c5_i = mean_{j in D5_i} h_j (root i); empty bucket -> zero context and zero change
